 ‘Invincible’ Season 5 to Premiere Feb. 17; Teaser Features Burger Mart
 Thursday, 19 November 2026, 19:05 
 Photo source: Variety 
 Mark faces choices that could put his closest relationships and the planet’s future at risk in the fifth season of “Invincible.” 
 Prime Video has set Feb. 17 as the premiere date for Season 5 and released a teaser featuring the series’ fast-food chain, Burger Mart.
 This is reported by Variety .
 The new season picks up after the “Earth-shattering events” of Season 4. According to the series logline, “Mark searches for a way to make the world better, even if that means risking everything - including the relationships, friends and allies he holds dear. Mark’s forced to decide what kind of hero he is and what he’s willing to do to save his planet’s future - and if the ends always justify the means when millions of lives hang in the balance.”
 Advertisement 
 The animated series is based on the comic book by co-creators Robert Kirkman and Cory Walker, with contributing creator Ryan Ottley. It stars Steven Yeun, Sandra Oh and J.K. Simmons.
 The adult animated superhero series has received three consecutive Primetime Emmy Award nominations for its voice casting. Amazon says Season 4 became the most-watched season in the series’ history.
